steps.body: Two parts and a total make a fact family: 6, 8 and 14 give 6+8, 8+6, 14−6 and 14−8.
steps.narration: Two parts and a total make a fact family: 6, 8 and 14 give 6+8, 8+6, 14−6 and 14−8.

widget.prompt: Start at 6 and hop forward 8 to find the family's total.

commonLandings.feedback: That names the second part rather than the total the two parts make.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 6 and make 8 hops right, one number at a time.

predict.prompt: The parts are 6 and 8. How many facts does this family hold?
predict.reveal: 6+8, 8+6, 14−6 and 14−8 all come from the same three numbers.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2f fact families.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for g2f fact families must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines g2f fact families.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Knowing one fact of the family gives the other three.

commonErrors.feedback: That repeats the total instead of removing 8 from it.
That repeats 8 instead of the other part of the family.

widget.fallbackFeedback: The family's two parts are 6 and 8.
widget.successFeedback: Correct — the parts are 6 and 8, so 14 − 8 = 6.

hints: The family has two parts and a total.
